items.body:
## Summary

On Windows, `sameIdentity()` compares `st_dev` between a **descriptor** stat (`fstatSync(fd)`) and a **name** stat (`lstatSync(path)`). On my machine those two values never agree, so `readStableRegularFile()` throws `"<kind> changed before it was read"` for every single input.

The effect is total: `gate-check.mjs` cannot read any ledger, the Stop hook cannot read its own state, and `install-hooks.mjs` refuses to touch settings. A clean clone gives `5/32 passed` in `tests/run-tests.mjs` and `npm test` stops there.
